zh:
過半的 BTC 供給在虧損：獲利的只剩 46.4%，一個月前還有 68.4%。
這種估值以前只在熊市底部區出現，但賣壓還在加深，長期持有者也開始賠錢賣。

・市場階段：牛市（第 41 天）
・ETF 7 個交易日（至 11/17）：−11.17 億美元

短線偏空：三天的橫盤往下破了，主動賣回來、ETF 11/17 又流出 2.4 億美元，持多單的帳戶還有 73%。
長線偏多：獲利的供給只剩 46%，未實現獲利第 5 天在週期地板下，這種估值過去只在週期底部區出現。
收盤跌破 62K，下面到 60.5K 籌碼很薄，長期持有者的虧損比例會創這輪新高；ETF 連續流入才算有人接。

en:
More than half of BTC supply is now at a loss: just 46.4% is in profit, down from 68.4% a month ago.
That valuation has only shown up in bear-market bottom zones, yet selling is still deepening and long-term holders are now selling at a loss too.

・Market stage: bull (day 41)
・ETF 7 trading days to Nov 17: −$1.12B

Short-term bearish: the three-day range broke down, active selling returned, ETFs lost another $240M on Nov 17 and 73% of accounts are still long.
Long-term bullish: only 46% of supply is in profit and unrealized profit has sat below the cycle floor for 5 days, a valuation seen only in past cycle-bottom zones.
Below a 62K close few coins sit down to 60.5K, where long-term holder losses would set a cycle high; it takes a run of ETF inflows to say buyers are back.
